title: SSB Head Görgün at NATO EDGE 26: “We Must Move Faster, Widen Our Ecosystem and Produce More”
excerpt: At the opening of NATO EDGE 26, held in Türkiye for the first time in İzmir, Presidency of Defence Industries head Prof. Dr. Haluk Görgün said the Alliance needs faster decisions, a broader industrial base and higher production capacity.
rank_math_title: NATO EDGE 26: Görgün's “move faster, produce more” message | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Haluk Görgün spoke at the opening of NATO EDGE 26 in İzmir: 284 companies, 30 Turkish organisations, a 56% NATO export share, ALFA 2026 and NATO Engine.
